dogecoin.text:
Even when @elonmusk hasn't tweeted about #Dogecoin, why is it rallying to brand new record high values?

Typically, when $DOGE price ⬆️, it’s due to influencers -#Dogecoinarmy.

But the price has surged by 40% in a strong rally to bag a new record high #trading.

#dogetothemoon https://t.co/s4pjsMmMBZ

$DOGE, the meme #cryptocurrency of #Dogecoin, rose 123% in the past seven days as the #altcoin market saw a resurgence in momentum.

Here's an interesting read from @Cointelegraph 

https://t.co/Du7z2bqLgg

#DogecoinToTheMoon #BTC #Bitcoin #Crypto $CNT $BTC $ETH

Now after @elonmusk tweets about #dogecoin, a 12% pump was witnessed!

$DOGE has jumped almost 12% since Musk's casual tweet on the Binance exchange, coming awfully close to a new #ATH.

It has been seen the #billionaire easily moves the prices of #cryptocurrencies with his tweet https://t.co/bq0wkJsCEp

Most #altcoins are in the red. 

#ETH is more than 7% down on a 24-hour scale. #BNB (-6%) is below $500. #XRP (-16%), #ADA (-10%), #DOT (-13%), #LTC (-10%), #BCH (-13%), #UNI (-8%), & #LINK (-12%) in red.

One exception is #dogecoin that ⬆️20%. $DOGE has gone up by 455% in a week https://t.co/3NPAf7ZN4J

Online retailer @Newegg has introduced support for #Dogecoin $DOGE payments on its platform, boosting the #cryptocurrency's price considerably.

#DOGE has been added as a payment option via @BitPay. It has risen by over 20% in the past 20 hours.

#doge420 #DogecoinToTheMoon https://t.co/36I5PrQ8Sz

#Bitcoin saw spot volumes, not seen since Feb & record derivatives over the weekend. #Eth declined, while the #cryptocurrency #dogecoin saw a double-digit percentage ⬆️

$BTC near the 10-hour but below the 50-hour moving avg, a sideways signal for market technicians.

$DOGE $ETH https://t.co/Iv1cc9vqyc

The #altcoins suffered as #bitcoin but have begun recovering as well with some impressive price pumps

#BinanceCoin #BNB has spiked by more than 12%. #Ripple (11%) #Cardano (9%) #Polkadot (12%) #Uniswap (20%) #Litecoin (8%) are in the green. #Dogecoin acts with a slight decrease. https://t.co/nzABW2hbnr

Most #altcoins have performed well!

#ETH jumped to yet another record above $2,760. #BinanceCoin (5.5%), #Ripple (7%), #Cardano (9.5%), #Polkadot (3.5%), #Dogecoin (1.3%) in the green.

#Uniswap has surged the most with a 12% increase. As a result, UNI trades well above $42. https://t.co/pylZyg8GIH
